name: damn-ddd
description: When a turn runs long, a cowboy whips a bucket of tokens (damn1) or a hero cuts an evil token in two (damn2), taking turns. UI only, zero model tokens.

startAfter.title: Show starts after (seconds)
startAfter.description: Seconds a turn may run before the show starts (default 600 = 10 min). It speeds up at 1.5x this and again at 2x.
